title: cloud/sandbox docs reference cloud/factory paths that moved in ticfac
description:
ticfac vendors cloud/sandbox from this repository at a pinned ref, verified byte-for-byte in CI. Its README.md, common.sh and worker.sh reference cloud/factory/src/... for the control-plane files they describe.

Those files moved twice on the ticfac side: l9n moved cloud/factory to cloudflare/, then k4s moved the sandbox tree itself to image/. Neither move could fix these references, and that is correct behaviour rather than an oversight — editing a vendored, digest-pinned tree in place is how a pin stops meaning anything.

So the fix has to be authored HERE. Afterwards ticfac moves sandbox.pin.json's ref and runs `go run ./cmd/sandbox sync`.

Work: update the three files to name the control-plane files at their current ticfac paths. Check for any other cloud/factory reference in cloud/sandbox while you are in there — grep rather than fixing the three named.

Reported by ticfac run epic-ncv, tick k4s, finding e4b05859. Originally raised by l9n as finding 4c8a55f8.
acceptance_criteria: No file under cloud/sandbox references cloud/factory; ticfac can re-pin and sync without its byte-for-byte check failing
